invariants.rationale: map is used to access properties and tile sets, so it must not be null.
parentLayers is used to add a layer, so it must not be null.
element is used extensively to retrieve layer data, so it must not be null.
The method assumes element can provide string and integer properties, which is possible if element is an object-type JsonValue.
The code retrieves map.getTileSets(), and expects the result to be non-null for tile lookups.
